observations: Two upholstered sofas in a tiled room.
Both sofas have a brown or taupe color.
Each sofa has a decorative diamond-shaped patch on the armrest with a logo.
The sofas appear to be in good cosmetic condition.
A watermark 'POSTED ON JIJI PHEEBS AUDU' is visible across the center of the image.

claims.claim: Bought new last year, no stain, no tear, foam still firm. From a smoke free home.
claims.evidence: No photo shows this; it is the seller's word only.

risks.risk: The sofas may be used or have hidden stains not visible in the photo.
risks.proof: A photo of the sofas with a handwritten note showing the purchase date.

risks.risk: The foam may be compressed or the cushions may be sagging.
risks.proof: A photo of the sofas with a person sitting on them.

risks.risk: The armrest patches may be missing or the logo may be damaged.
risks.proof: A close-up photo of the armrest patches.

proof_requests: Close-up of any label, sticker or metal plate showing the brand and model.
Photo of the sofas with a person sitting on them to check the foam.
Photo of the armrest patches to check for missing or damaged logos.
Photo of the underside of the sofas to check for stains or wear.
response.reason: The item is clearly identifiable as a set of two sofas from the photos. While the condition is unverified, it can be priced at its worst-case value as used.
